facts.fact: Triomphe Mag, citing ANIP's report of 24 February 2026, describes the Registre National des Personnes Physiques (RNPP) as set up by ANIP and gaining data from the birth registration pilot.
Triomphe Mag, citing ANIP's report of 24 February 2026, says births registered at the ten pilot health facilities since 20 August 2025 enrich the RNPP, with 30,160 number updates recorded.
